verdict.rationale: Zulip documents a bot API/framework for building custom bots that react to messages and can be deployed persistently via the Zulip Botserver, plus 130+ native integrations and incoming webhooks, which together enable background automation. However, this requires custom coding and self-managed hosting rather than a native no-code scheduler or autonomous agent runtime. Missing for 10: built-in scheduling/triggers UI, first-party autonomous agent hosting, independent hands-on evidence of bots running unattended long-term.
